bio.text: Julie Fortier is the Democratic candidate for Illinois' 12th Congressional District in 2026; the Daily Egyptian reported in January that she was the only Democrat in the March primary.
The Daily Egyptian reports she has lived in O'Fallon for over 30 years and served in the Air Force.
WSIU reports she earned degrees in biology and mathematics from McKendree and a PhD in biomedical sciences from Saint Louis University.
